criteria.no: The specific obligation is absent, merely topical, replaced by a contrary decision, or untriggered because the item is expressly outside the anchor scope.
criteria.unclear: An obligation is alluded to but its presence cannot be determined.
criteria.yes: CI resolves the lowest allowed set and the latest allowed set and runs affected tests at both endpoints, including affected generated/consumer workspaces.

addressed.instructions: Does a concrete step or constraint in the item carry this policy: dependency CI resolves and tests both minimum and latest allowed versions of changed registry ranges in every affected workspace and feature set? Distinguish a commitment from merely discussing its subject.

criteria.no: No explicit incompatible decision is stated, including silence, topic-only discussion, compliance, and excluded work: prose-only README edits without range or validation changes.
criteria.unclear: A stated action may conflict, but its relevant details cannot be determined.
criteria.yes: CI explicitly tests only one endpoint, skips affected workspace endpoint tests, or substitutes a documented command for actual endpoint tests.

contradicted.instructions: Does a stated decision within scope break this rule: dependency CI resolves and tests both minimum and latest allowed versions of changed registry ranges in every affected workspace and feature set? Evaluate actual incompatible actions, not omissions.

criteria.no: The work concerns only prose-only README edits without range or validation changes or unrelated activities.
criteria.unclear: The work area is insufficiently specified.
criteria.yes: The item changes, preserves, or explicitly specifies registry dependency range changes or dependency validation for root, generated-template features, or separate consumer/test workspaces.

relevant.instructions: Determine whether the described work falls within registry dependency range changes or dependency validation for root, generated-template features, or separate consumer/test workspaces. Apply the scope exclusions even when excluded work mentions the same tool or dependency.
